title: Potentiometer knob
prompt: Simple round knob for a potentiometer with a 6 mm round shaft: 30 mm diameter, 15 mm tall, a 6 mm hole 10 mm deep from the bottom for the shaft, and a 2 mm 45° chamfer around the top edge.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
The top chamfer is one conical face
Three flat faces: bottom, top, and the end of the blind shaft hole
Two cylindrical faces: the outside and the shaft hole
Volume π·15²·15 − Ø6×10 bore − 2 mm chamfer ring ≈ 10140 mm³ ±1%

notes: A blind hole and a chamfer in one body need a revolve in IR v0.
